reviewer: Agent under explicit project operator authorization
scope: Reusable private acquisition and local candidate processing while the provider terms, endpoint access, and upstream-data conditions remain unchanged and publicly accessible; public redistribution and publication are not approved.
notes: Basis: project operator authorization for reusable compliant private source pipelines plus the cited provider notice, reviewed at the recorded timestamp. EPA states that EPA-produced data are by default public domain unless otherwise specified. ECHO uses ICIS-NPDES and FRS data and can include state-reported inputs, so this is not a legal guarantee or an assertion of rights for every upstream value. Recheck provider terms and access on refresh; stop and review if they change. Preserve source attribution/provenance; retain names, addresses, and coordinates in restricted staging pending privacy and location review. Do not claim confirmed CAFO status, current operation, completeness, or publication approval.
